summary: Sunshine Biopharma Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a placement agent agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. for a best-efforts public offering of 11,160,000 common units (each consisting of one share and two Series C warrants) at $0.50 per unit and 840,000 pre-funded units at $0.49999 each. The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.00001; Series C warrants have a $0.50 initial exercise price, five-year term, with an anti-dilution adjustment triggered by a share combination event to minimum $0.25, contingent on Nasdaq stockholder approval. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
